decision_class: ordered bounded policy profiles h:[0,1]->[0,1] observed on declared ordered grids

profile_coordinate.linear_coefficients: exact integrals of cosine basis functions over the Voronoi cells of the piecewise-constant profile reconstruction
profile_coordinate.quadratic_expansion: append c_k^2 for every retained coefficient; no cross-products
profile_coordinate.target_inverse_map: piecewise-linear interpolation from reference nodes to declared target nodes followed by deterministic integer rounding

source_score.across_task_aggregation: uniform average in the domain-blind primary method
source_score.robust_source_feasible: estimated chance margin <= 0 in every source task
source_score.robust_source_feasible_role: reported diagnostic only; it does not filter the finite library

selection.augmented_coordinate: z-scored profile coordinate concatenated with sqrt(1)*source safety rank and sqrt(1)*source objective rank
selection.remaining_centers: Gonzalez farthest-first in Euclidean augmented-coordinate distance
selection.tie_breaking: stable profile identifier, then lowest finite-library index
